children: credit default swaps hovered near a three-year high as investors assessed the potential impact of the company’s funding plans for OpenAI
Five-year CDS were indicated at around 383.2 basis points, close to their highest level since 2023,

SoftBank has committed $64.6B to OpenAI. The ChatGPT maker, one of SoftBank’s biggest bets, is in early talks with investors about a new funding round that could value the company at more than $1.2T ahead of an initial public offering.
OpenAI chief executive officer Sam Altman told Fortune that the long-awaited IPO remains in the works but is not expected to take place this year.

SoftBank recently raised ¥1T through a retail bond offering in Japan and is also preparing for a potential overseas bond sale. A wider CDS spread could increase borrowing costs and weigh on terms for future debt issuance.

title: SoftBank credit default swaps near three-year high amid OpenAI funding push
